title: CIA psychiatrist explains why Hall was chosen: 41 men before him came back compromised

tellings.quote: He said the 41 men that went out before me who all came back compromised and some of them burned.

plain: The story is that in the 1960s, on the Nevada weapons ranges, a CIA psychiatrist told a man named Charles Hall why he had been picked: 41 men had gone out before him and all came back compromised, some of them burned. Hall tells this himself, as someone who says he spent three years with tall white aliens near Area 51, a secret Air Force site in Nevada, and repeats the unnamed psychiatrist's words, a story he also tells in his book Millennial Hospitality. If true, the government was sending men into contact with these beings and losing many of them.
